learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to read and understand easy texts.
Students will be able to write letters with simple sentences and introduce themselves and others.
Students will be able to listen to and understand daily conversations at a beginner level; introduce themselves and others with simple sentences and express themselves.
Students will be able to recognize and use beginner-level vocabulary related to daily life.
Students will gain independent study skills by completing internet assignments given to them through technology and can access all course materials via Moodle.

syllabus_topics: Ability to express oneself with appropriate time structures, especially to articulate daily life needs, will be developed.
Learned structures will be reinforced with simple reading texts and listening activities.
